name: FacturLint EU E-Invoicing
author: facturlint

sections.description:
FacturLint EU E-Invoicing connects your WooCommerce store to the stateless FacturLint compliance engine to automatically issue European e-invoices compliant with EN 16931, Factur-X 1.09.2 (France 2026/2027), ZUGFeRD 2.5, and XRechnung 3.0 (Germany B2B mandate).

Key Features

  • Automatic e-invoice generation on woocommerce_order_status_completed via POST /v1/generate (target_standard: facturx-en16931, zugferd-2.5, xrechnung-ubl, xrechnung-cii).
  • Supports Factur-X 1.09.2 (PDF/A-3b), ZUGFeRD 2.5, and XRechnung 3.0 (UBL 2.1 & CII) with seller contact fields (BT-41/BT-42/BT-43).
  • Seller profile presets for France (FR), Germany (DE), and Cross-Border EU (EN).
  • Automatic buyer EU VAT ID (USt-IdNr / TVA intracommunautaire) & SIRET metadata mapping.
  • 1-Click API Key & monthly quota check directly from WooCommerce settings.
  • High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) compatible (custom_order_tables).
  • Zero invoice retention on FacturLint servers: documents are generated in RAM and stored directly in your store’s protected uploads folder.

External services

This plugin connects your WooCommerce store to the external FacturLint API SaaS (https://facturlint.com) to validate EU VAT numbers, verify API key quotas, and generate EN 16931 electronic invoices.

  • Invoice Generation (https://facturlint.com/v1/generate): When a WooCommerce order reaches the Completed status (and automatic generation is enabled), order metadata (invoice number, issue date, seller profile, buyer billing name/address/VAT ID, line items, currency, and totals) is sent over HTTPS to FacturLint to build a compliant Factur-X 1.09.2, ZUGFeRD 2.5, or XRechnung 3.0 file.
  • Key & Quota Verification (https://facturlint.com/v1/quota): When an administrator clicks 1-Click Check Key & Quota in plugin settings, the configured API key is sent to check plan status and monthly allowance.
  • EU VAT Verification (https://facturlint.com/v1/verify-eu-vat): Optional helper method to validate EU VAT IDs.
  • Zero Retention: All requests are processed statelessly in RAM with zero invoice document retention on FacturLint servers.
  • Terms of Use & Privacy Policy: Provided at facturlint.com/legal?lang=en (English) and facturlint.com/legal (French).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the facturlint-eu-e-invoicing folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open WooCommerce > FacturLint E-Invoicing, enter your FacturLint API key, click 1-Click Check Key & Quota, and save your seller profile.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support WooCommerce HPOS (Custom Order Tables)?

Yes. HPOS compatibility is explicitly declared on before_woocommerce_init.

Are customer invoices stored on FacturLint servers?

No. FacturLint operates 100% statelessly in RAM with zero document retention.

Which EU standards are supported?

Factur-X 1.09.2 (EN 16931), ZUGFeRD 2.5, and XRechnung 3.0.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release: WooCommerce order completion hook, Factur-X 1.09.2 / ZUGFeRD 2.5 / XRechnung 3.0 generation, FR/DE/EN seller presets, EU VAT metadata support, HPOS support, and 1-click key verification.
